result.title: Planning under Noise with Neural Operators
result.summary: Planning under uncertain control execution noise requires reliable feedback policies across diverse environments. We introduce Planning Under Noise (PUN), a neural operator that learns noise-aware value fields for planning in unseen geometries. Building on an established screened-Poisson formulation of stochastic optimal control, we address two challenges: specifying boundary conditions that support navigation across varying geometries and efficiently computing fields with reliable gradients. Zero-Dirichlet obstacle boundaries terminate sampled paths at walls, weakening the goal signal along long routes and making it harder to estimate reliably. We instead impose reflecting Neumann conditions on obstacles and a Dirichlet condition at the goal, allowing sampled paths to continue exploring free space until they reach the target. To solve the resulting PDE without a configuration-space mesh, we extend a Monte Carlo (MC) solver, Walk on Stars (WoSt), to higher dimensions. However, local MC fluctuations can reverse estimated gradient directions and cause planning failures, making direct planning require costly sampling. PUN amortizes this computation by learning geometry-to-field mappings from noisy, partially converged Monte Carlo labels, avoiding expensive convergence for every training example. At inference, test-time scaling uses bounded local search guided by the predicted global field. We evaluate PUN on planning tasks across dimensions. Across four noise levels, PUN matches or outperforms all compared planners, achieving 95-100% success on the 4D replanning benchmark while maintaining the lowest runtime. At the highest tested noise level in 4D, PUN achieves 10.7-60.6% relative gains in success rate over other methods while running 3.29-32.15 times faster.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PUN：一种神经算子，从带噪且未完全收敛的 Monte Carlo 标签中学习「几何→噪声感知值场」映射，用障碍物反射 Neumann 与目标 Dirichlet 边界求解 screened-Poisson 随机最优控制问题，并在推理时以受约束的局部搜索做 test-time scaling。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用神经算子摊销昂贵求解、容忍部分收敛标签、推理期以有界局部搜索分配算力」的做法，可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态训练监督与动态计算、停止决策提供线索；值场梯度可靠性分析是否对应 latent 证据筛选与近似的可靠性，值得核查。
